tests.title: Role period is saved with the dates picked in the calendar
tests.goal: Role validity periods (used to enable VET IC and Stocktaker roles for FAVE) keep the chosen dates.
preconditions: Logged in as the test account (`SPF_USER` in .env) with Agency Admin active
data: Start Date the 13th, End Date the 20th of next month

steps.text: User > Role Listing > pencil of End User > Periods > Add Period
Pick Start Date the 13th and End Date the 20th of next month, Submit
Cleanup: delete the new period (trash icon)

expected.text: Step 2 shows "Period has been successfully saved."
The Periods table lists the period with exactly the picked dates (dd-Mon-yyyy)
Step 3 shows "Period <start> to <end> has been successfully deleted." and the table is back to its previous rows

notes: End User > Periods > Add Period 13/12/2026 to 20/12/2026 (calendar clicks), Submit: 'SqlDateTime overflow. Must be between 1/1/1753 12:00:00 AM and 12/31/9999 11:59:59 PM.'; nothing saved
